LOGICAL_REVIEWER = DJANGO
AUTHENTICATED_CONNECTOR_ACTOR = Dunkan-Sparx / 320955571
STATUS = DJANGO PASS WITH PATCHES / DESIGN-ONLY
IMPLEMENTATION = NOT AUTHORIZED
LIVE_ACCOUNT_ACCESS = NO
PUBLISH_AUTHORITY = NO
AUTO_REPLY = NO
AUTOMATION = NO
AUTO_PROMOTION = NO

SOURCE BASIS
- current ZB SOCIAL OPERATIONS AGENT design discussion / LYNCH boundary acceptance
- #76 ZORR BLATT STUDIO CONSTITUTION R02
- #82 RENALDO OWNER APPROVED / LOCKED charter

ARCHITECTURE VERDICT
The concept is coherent only if SOCIAL OPERATIONS is an execution/packaging/triage layer beneath approved campaign/distribution authority. It MUST NOT become a second RENALDO, release authority, rights authority, canon authority, commercial authority, or autonomous publisher.

ACCEPTED CORE LAWS
`STALE POLICY KNOWLEDGE != PUBLISH PERMISSION.`
`CREATIVE PASS != GOVERNANCE PASS.`
`OPTIMIZE THE PACKAGE — NOT THE TRUTH.`
`FAST RESPONSE MUST NEVER OUTRUN AUTHORITY.`
`MARKETING MAY AMPLIFY PRODUCTION TRUTH. IT MAY NEVER RUN AHEAD OF PRODUCTION TRUTH.`
`SOCIAL EXECUTION AUTHORITY != CAMPAIGN / DISTRIBUTION AUTHORITY.`
`CONTENT_READY + GOVERNANCE_READY != PUBLISH_AUTHORIZED.`
`AUDIENCE SIGNAL != CANON / RIGHTS / RELEASE AUTHORITY.`

DJANGO REQUIRED PATCHES

D1 — SOCIAL IS SUBORDINATE EXECUTION, NOT PARALLEL CAMPAIGN AUTHORITY
RENALDO remains responsible for campaign intent / distribution readiness inside #82 boundaries. SOCIAL may package/localize/queue/triage/measure only from exact upstream refs. SOCIAL may not choose public positioning, campaign objective, launch priority, territory, release promise, partnership, spend, or substantive audience strategy as autonomous authority.

Law:
`SOCIAL TASK AUTHORITY MUST TRACE TO RENALDO/JINGO/OWNER-APPROVED SCOPE.`
`NO CAMPAIGN INTENT REF -> HOLD.`

D2 — THREE DISTINCT STATES + EXACT-SCOPE PUBLISH AUTHORIZATION
Required states:
`CONTENT_READY`
`GOVERNANCE_READY`
`PUBLISH_AUTHORIZED`

`PUBLISH_AUTHORIZED` must be explicit and bound at minimum to:
- SOCIAL_POST_MANIFEST id + version/hash
- exact platform
- exact account identity
- locale/territory where relevant
- organic vs paid/sponsored mode
- disclosure state
- allowed publication window / schedule if time-sensitive
- exact authorization ref / authority

Any material change to media, copy, links, disclosure, platform/account, locale, rights/release evidence, or scheduled scope invalidates prior publish authorization and requires re-gating.

Law:
`READY IS NOT TIMELESS AUTHORITY.`
`MATERIAL CHANGE AFTER READY -> READY EXPIRES.`

D3 — JUST-IN-TIME REVALIDATION BEFORE EXECUTION
Immediately before any future publish attempt, re-check exact manifest bindings and freshness of release/rights/availability/policy/disclosure evidence. Platform policy check is evidence, not substantive legal/right authority.

Fail closed:
`STALE / MISSING / UNRESOLVED POLICY OR DISCLOSURE EVIDENCE -> HOLD.`
`RIGHTS / RELEASE / AVAILABILITY CHANGED OR UNKNOWN -> NO PUBLISH.`
`UNCERTAINTY DOES NOT GRANT PERMISSION.`

D4 — IDEMPOTENT PUBLISH + UNKNOWN RESULT SAFETY
Future publisher must have replay/duplicate protection keyed by exact manifest + platform + account. A timeout/network error MUST NOT be interpreted as "publish failed" and retried blindly.

Law:
`UNKNOWN PUBLISH RESULT -> VERIFY BEFORE RETRY.`
`DUPLICATE / CONFLICTING PUBLICATION STATE -> STOP.`

Publication verification record should bind:
- manifest id/version/hash
- platform/account
- returned platform post id/permalink when available
- execution timestamp
- publication status
- verification evidence

D5 — EDIT / DELETE / TAKEDOWN AUTHORITY IS SEPARATE
Permission to publish does not grant permission to edit, delete, replace, hide, pin, boost, or materially alter a live post.

Law:
`PUBLISH AUTHORITY != MUTATION / DELETE / BOOST AUTHORITY.`

If a post is discovered to contain factual/canon/rights/release/disclosure risk after publication:
`FREEZE NEW DISTRIBUTION -> RECORD INCIDENT -> ROUTE TO DOMAIN AUTHORITY -> EXECUTE TAKEDOWN/EDIT ONLY WITH EXPLICIT AUTHORITY`, except any separately defined emergency safety/security takedown law.

D6 — ACCOUNT / CREDENTIAL BOUNDARY
Future live access must use verified account identity and scoped connector/secret capability. Credentials/tokens must not be carried in prompts, benchmark cases, chat memory, or manifests. No silent fallback to another account/page/workspace when exact target access fails.

Law:
`ACCOUNT NAME != VERIFIED ACCOUNT IDENTITY.`
`TARGET ACCOUNT UNVERIFIED / ACCESS MISSING -> STOP.`
`NO CREDENTIAL MATERIAL IN AGENT MEMORY.`

D7 — COMMUNITY TRIAGE != REPLY AUTHORITY
Community triage may classify/rank/route public interaction. It does not imply permission to reply, DM, promise, negotiate, moderate, delete, block, or engage a brand/press/partner.

Current default:
`AUTO_REPLY = NO.`
`BRAND / PRESS / PARTNERSHIP / RIGHTS / RELEASE / SAFETY / HARASSMENT / LEGAL-SENSITIVE -> ROUTE, NO AUTONOMOUS RESPONSE.`

Any future reply authority must be scope-specific, with approved response class and escalation rules. Fast response may never outrun factual/canon/release/commercial authority.

D8 — LOCALIZATION / METRICS ARE NON-AUTHORITY TRANSFORMS
Localization may optimize phrasing/format but may not alter factual meaning, canon meaning, release promise, rights implication, disclosure, or availability. Material semantic change -> HUNTER/JINGO/other applicable re-check.

Metrics and viral signals are append-only evidence inputs. Metric definition/source/window must be preserved for comparisons; changed platform definitions invalidate naive trend comparison.

Law:
`LOCALIZATION MAY CHANGE LANGUAGE, NOT TRUTH.`
`METRICS MAY INFORM; THEY MAY NOT AUTHORIZE.`
`VIRALITY DOES NOT RETROACTIVELY VALIDATE A BAD POST.`

SOCIAL POST MANIFEST — MINIMUM ARCHITECTURAL FIELDS
- manifestId / version / content hash
- campaignIntentRef
- asset refs + hashes
- copy/source refs
- platform + verified account target
- locale/territory
- organic/paid/sponsored mode
- disclosure requirements/evidence
- HUNTER factual/copy evidence where applicable
- SALVADOR visual evidence where canon-sensitive
- JINGO release-readiness ref
- substantive rights/availability evidence ref
- RENALDO_DISTRIBUTION_READY ref when required by campaign flow
- platform-policy evidence + checkedAt/expiry or freshness rule
- publishAuthorizationRef
- schedule/window
- supersedes/revokes refs if applicable

CONTENT QUALITY BOUNDARY
SOCIAL may perform mechanical/package-quality checks (format, length, crop, encoding, link presence, platform fit). It may NOT reinterpret this as canon/content/factual approval.

`PACKAGE QC != CONTENT/CANON APPROVAL.`

ERROR REGISTRY
SOC01–SOC14 may remain append-only. Critical classes including FAKE_FANDOM, CANON_INVENTION, RELEASE/RIGHTS/COMMERCIAL_OVERREACH block promotion regardless of creative quality/metrics. IDs may never be silently reassigned.

FAIL-CLOSED STATE SUMMARY
`MISSING CAMPAIGN INTENT -> HOLD`
`MISSING CONTENT EVIDENCE -> HOLD`
`MISSING RIGHTS / RELEASE / AVAILABILITY -> NO PUBLISH`
`STALE POLICY / DISCLOSURE -> HOLD`
`MISSING EXACT PUBLISH AUTHORIZATION -> NO PUBLISH`
`TARGET ACCOUNT UNKNOWN -> STOP`
`MANIFEST CHANGED AFTER AUTH -> AUTH EXPIRES`
`UNKNOWN PUBLISH RESULT -> VERIFY BEFORE RETRY`
`DUPLICATE / CONFLICT -> STOP`
`POST-PUBLISH GOVERNANCE INCIDENT -> FREEZE NEW DISTRIBUTION + ROUTE`

TRAINING BOUNDARY
Future 5 synthetic SOCIAL cases are permitted only as design/training evidence after JINGO allocates a slot. Learner must not author its own traps. Same shared-runtime limitation applies: no genuine holdout/generalization certification unless evaluator/learner isolation is real.

NEXT SAFE STEP
`JINGO -> decide whether to formalize SOCIAL OPERATIONS charter/spec candidate under D1-D8.`
Only after a durable reviewed spec exists may JINGO allocate the 5-case synthetic baseline.

NO LIVE ACCOUNT
NO REAL PUBLISH
NO AUTOMATION
NO AUTO-REPLY
NO AUTO-PROMOTION
NO IMPLEMENTATION
